name: Acyclic Trace-Carrier Scheme
statement: A finite nonempty ample family $H$ belongs to the dismantlable ample classes exactly when it admits the following data. Bijections assign each shattered support $D$ a distinct carrier $\kappa(D)\in H$. For every other trace $q$ on $D$, choose a protector $p(D,q)$ realizing $q$. Direct every other concept having the carrier trace toward $\kappa(D)$, and direct $\kappa(D)$ toward each chosen protector. The resulting precedence digraph must be acyclic.
recognition_complexity: Finite search over support-to-concept bijections and selected trace-fiber representatives, followed by directed-cycle detection. The criterion removes the total-order variable but is not claimed polynomial-time.
comments: Protector choices are essential: replacing a chosen protector by every member of its trace fiber already makes the criterion fail on the square.
